task: Select dynamically expressed molecular features that preserve continuous cellular trajectories from single-cell protein imaging data.
named_method_commitments: validation against random and high-variance feature baselines
planned_method: derive full-feature reference trajectory using PCA, nearest-neighbor graph, diffusion maps/pseudotime or robust PCA-derived surrogate if DPT unavailable
score each molecular feature by dynamic association with pseudotime using Spearman correlation, mutual information, and smoothness/ANOVA across trajectory bins
validate preservation using subset embeddings vs full reference: pseudotime correlation, neighbor overlap/trustworthiness, branch/cluster retention if labels exist
compare selected set with high variance and random baselines
